rows.requirement: Keep passageways and work surfaces clean and orderly.
rows.cue: Clutter or stored items in a walkway.

rows.requirement: Keep floors clean and, as far as possible, dry.
rows.cue: Spill or wet floor with no sign or cleanup.

rows.requirement: Keep surfaces free of hazards such as sharp objects, loose boards, leaks, and spills.
rows.cue: Loose board, protruding object, or leak on the floor.

rows.requirement: Provide a safe way to get to and from a work surface. Make workers use it.
rows.cue: Worker climbs onto equipment or a platform with no safe access.

rows.requirement: Correct a hazard on a surface before anyone uses it again. If you cannot, guard the hazard.
rows.cue: Damaged floor or platform in use with no barrier.

rows.requirement: Use a ladder only for the purpose it was designed for.
rows.cue: Ladder used as a bench, brace, or walkway.

rows.requirement: Tag a defective ladder "Dangerous: Do Not Use". Remove it from service.
rows.cue: Damaged ladder in use, or in place with no tag.

rows.requirement: Face the ladder when you climb up or down.
rows.cue: Worker climbs with their back to the ladder.

rows.requirement: Hold the ladder with at least one hand when you climb.
rows.cue: Worker climbs with both hands off the ladder.

rows.requirement: Do not carry an object that can make you lose balance when you climb.
rows.cue: Worker climbs with a large box or tool in their arms.

rows.requirement: Use a portable ladder only on a stable, level surface, unless it is secured.
rows.cue: Ladder on a slope, soft ground, or an unsteady base.

rows.requirement: Do not move, shift, or extend a ladder while a person is on it.
rows.cue: Worker shifts the ladder by rocking or leaning.

rows.requirement: Secure a ladder in a passageway, doorway, or driveway where traffic can move it.
rows.cue: Unsecured ladder in a doorway or aisle.

rows.requirement: Do not use the cap or top step of a stepladder as a step.
rows.cue: Worker stands on the top step.

rows.requirement: Do not put a ladder on boxes, barrels, or other unstable bases.
rows.cue: Ladder stands on a box or barrel.

rows.requirement: Provide handrails and stair rails as 1910.28 requires.
rows.cue: Stairs with an open side and no rail.

rows.requirement: Keep at least 6 ft 8 in (203 cm) of clear height above each stair tread.
rows.cue: Pipe or object hangs low over a stairway.

rows.requirement: Protect each worker at an unprotected edge that is 4 ft (1.2 m) or more above a lower level.
rows.cue: Worker at an open edge with no guardrail, net, or harness.

rows.requirement: Protect each worker from falling through a hole, or skylight, that is 4 ft or more above a lower level.
rows.cue: Open floor hole or skylight with no cover or rail.

rows.requirement: Protect each worker on a dockboard from falling 4 ft or more with a guardrail or handrails.
rows.cue: Worker on a dockboard with no rail.

rows.requirement: Protect a worker who is less than 4 ft above dangerous equipment from falling onto it.
rows.cue: Worker on a walkway above a machine with no rail.

rows.requirement: Keep each exit door unlocked.
rows.cue: Chained, padlocked, or locked exit door.

rows.requirement: Keep exit routes free of explosive or highly flammable furnishings and decorations.
rows.cue: Flammable material stored in an exit route.

rows.requirement: Keep exit routes free and unobstructed. Do not put materials or equipment in them, even for a short time.
rows.cue: Boxes, pallets, or equipment in an exit route.

rows.requirement: Keep emergency safeguards in working order. Examples: sprinklers, alarms, fire doors, exit lights.
rows.cue: Exit light off, or fire door propped open.

rows.requirement: Light each exit route well enough to see along it.
rows.cue: Dark exit route.

rows.requirement: Mark each exit with a sign that reads "Exit".
rows.cue: Exit door with no sign.

rows.requirement: Keep exit doors free of decorations or signs that hide them.
rows.cue: Poster or sign covers an exit door.

rows.requirement: Mark a door that could look like an exit "Not an Exit", or show its use, for example "Closet".
rows.cue: Unmarked door next to an exit.

rows.requirement: Keep manual alarm devices unobstructed and easy to reach.
rows.cue: Fire alarm pull station is blocked.

rows.requirement: Mount and place extinguishers so workers can reach them easily, without risk of injury.
rows.cue: Extinguisher behind boxes or equipment.

rows.requirement: Keep extinguishers charged and in their place, except when in use.
rows.cue: Extinguisher missing from its bracket.

rows.requirement: Provide, use, and maintain PPE wherever hazards need it.
rows.cue: Worker in a PPE area with no PPE.

rows.requirement: Do not use defective or damaged PPE.
rows.cue: Cracked goggles, torn gloves, or damaged helmet.

rows.requirement: Use eye or face protection when flying particles, molten metal, liquid chemicals, acids, caustics, gases, vapors, or harmful light can hurt the eyes or face.
rows.cue: Worker pours chemical or grinds with no goggles or face shield.

rows.requirement: Use eye protection with side protection when flying objects are a hazard.
rows.cue: Glasses with no side shields near grinding or cutting.

rows.requirement: Use filter lenses with the correct shade number for the light radiation of the work.
rows.cue: Welder or helper with no shaded lens.

rows.requirement: Wear a protective helmet where falling objects can hurt the head.
rows.cue: No hard hat under overhead work.

rows.requirement: Wear protective footwear where falling or rolling objects, or sharp objects, can hurt the feet.
rows.cue: Sandals or open shoes in a work area.

rows.requirement: Use hand protection when hands face hazards such as harmful chemicals, cuts, burns, or temperature extremes.
rows.cue: Bare hands on chemicals, hot parts, or sharp parts.

rows.requirement: Provide a respirator when it is necessary to protect the health of the worker.
rows.cue: Worker in a dust, fume, or spray area with no respirator.

rows.requirement: Label each workplace container of hazardous chemicals with the required information, or with words, pictures, or symbols that give the same information.
rows.cue: Unlabeled bottle, drum, or beaker.

rows.requirement: Keep labels legible, in English, and prominently displayed or readily available in the work area.
rows.cue: Faded, torn, or covered label.

rows.requirement: Keep safety data sheets (SDS) in the workplace. Make them readily accessible during each work shift.
rows.cue: No SDS binder or station near the chemicals.

rows.requirement: Provide quick drenching or flushing facilities where eyes or body can contact injurious corrosive materials.
rows.cue: Corrosive chemical in use with no eyewash or shower in view, or a blocked one.

rows.requirement: Prevent ignition of flammable vapors. Control sources of ignition such as open flames, smoking, and cutting and welding.
rows.cue: Open flame, smoking, or sparks near flammable liquids.

rows.requirement: Control leaks, clean spills, keep aisles clear, and keep combustible waste to a minimum in covered metal receptacles.
rows.cue: Flammable spill, blocked aisle, or oily rags in an open bin.

rows.requirement: Handle, store, and use compressed gas cylinders as CGA Pamphlet P-1 requires.
rows.cue: Cylinder not secured upright with a chain or stand.

rows.requirement: Post danger signs, or use an equal method, to show each permit-required confined space and its danger.
rows.cue: Open tank, vessel, or manhole with no sign.

rows.requirement: Guard the machine area against hazards such as the point of operation, nip points, rotating parts, flying chips, and sparks.
rows.cue: Guard removed or open on a running machine.

rows.requirement: Guard the point of operation if it can injure a worker.
rows.cue: Hands at the point of operation with no guard.

rows.requirement: Keep tools and equipment in a safe condition.
rows.cue: Damaged tool, taped handle, or frayed cord in use.

rows.requirement: Do not use compressed air for cleaning above 30 psi. Use chip guarding and PPE below that.
rows.cue: Worker blows air over clothes, skin, or a bench with no PPE.

rows.requirement: Apply lockout or tagout devices to each energy isolating device before servicing.
rows.cue: Worker inside a machine with no lock or tag on the isolator.

rows.requirement: Before you remove locks and restore energy, check that the work area is clear of tools and people.
rows.cue: Machine restarts while a person is in the machine area.

rows.requirement: Use a fire watcher when welding or cutting where more than a minor fire can start.
rows.cue: Welding near combustibles with no fire watcher.

rows.requirement: Close unused openings in boxes, cabinets, and equipment cases.
rows.cue: Open knockout or gap in an electrical box.

rows.requirement: Do not use the working space around electrical equipment for storage.
rows.cue: Boxes or equipment in front of an electrical panel.

rows.requirement: Guard live parts of 50 volts or more against accidental contact.
rows.cue: Open panel with exposed live parts.

rows.requirement: Fit covers on pull boxes, junction boxes, and fittings.
rows.cue: Junction box with no cover.

rows.requirement: Do not use flexible cords as fixed wiring, through walls, floors, doorways, or windows, or attached to building surfaces.
rows.cue: Extension cord run through a doorway or fixed to a wall.

rows.requirement: Do not drive a truck toward a person who stands in front of a bench or fixed object.
rows.cue: Forklift moves toward a worker at a bench.

rows.requirement: Do not let anyone stand or pass under the raised part of a truck.
rows.cue: Worker under raised forks or load.

rows.requirement: Do not let unauthorized people ride on a truck.
rows.cue: Person rides on the forks or truck body.

rows.requirement: When you leave a truck unattended, lower the forks, neutralize the controls, switch power off, and set the brakes.
rows.cue: Forklift left with forks raised and no driver.

rows.requirement: Obey traffic rules and speed limits. Keep about three truck lengths from the truck ahead.
rows.cue: Forklift speeds or follows too close.

rows.requirement: Leave safe clearance for aisles, docks, doorways, and turns where mechanical equipment is in use.
rows.cue: Aisle too narrow for the equipment.

rows.requirement: Store material so it does not create a hazard. Stack, block, and interlock tiers so they stay stable.
rows.cue: Leaning or unstable stack.

rows.requirement: Keep storage areas free of material that is a trip, fire, explosion, or pest hazard.
rows.cue: Clutter or waste in a storage area.

rows.requirement: Cover or guard open pits, tanks, vats, and ditches.
rows.cue: Open pit or vat with no cover or rail.

rows.requirement: Use yellow to mark physical hazards such as striking against, stumbling, falling, tripping, and caught-in-between.
rows.cue: Step edge, low beam, or floor hazard with no yellow marking.

rows.requirement: Make caution signs with a yellow background. Use black letters on the yellow background.
rows.cue: Caution sign in the wrong colors.

rows.requirement: Keep all places of employment clean, as far as the work allows.
rows.cue: Dirty or littered workplace.

rows.requirement: Use waste receptacles that do not leak and that you can clean.
rows.cue: Leaking or overflowing bin.

rows.requirement: Prevent rodents, insects, and other vermin from entering or living in the workplace.
rows.cue: Visible pest.

rows.requirement: Wear clean clothing that suits the duties. Wear head, face, hand, and arm coverings when needed to protect the product.
rows.cue: No hair cover, mask, gloves, or sleeves in a process area, or a dirty gown.

rows.requirement: Practice good sanitation and health habits.
rows.cue: Worker eats, drinks, or touches the face in a process area.

rows.requirement: Let only authorized people enter limited-access areas.
rows.cue: Unauthorized person enters a limited-access area.

rows.requirement: Keep a worker with an apparent illness or open lesion away from direct contact with materials and product.
rows.cue: Worker with a visible open wound handles open product.

rows.requirement: Give equipment and materials enough space for orderly placement. Design the flow to prevent mixups and contamination.
rows.cue: Material stored in disorder, or moves against the defined flow.

rows.requirement: Do each operation in a defined area of adequate size. Separate areas as needed to prevent contamination or mixups.
rows.cue: An operation outside its defined area.

rows.requirement: In aseptic areas, use smooth, hard, cleanable floors, walls, and ceilings.
rows.cue: Flaking paint, cracks, or rough surface in an aseptic area.

rows.requirement: In aseptic areas, supply HEPA-filtered air under positive pressure.
rows.cue: Door propped open in an aseptic area.

rows.requirement: Provide adequate lighting in all areas.
rows.cue: Dark work area.

rows.requirement: Provide equipment to control air pressure, micro-organisms, dust, humidity, and temperature where appropriate.
rows.cue: Cleanroom door held open, or a pressure gauge out of range.

rows.requirement: Provide adequate washing facilities: hot and cold water, soap, towels or air dryers, and toilets that are easy to reach from work areas.
rows.cue: Empty soap dispenser, no towels, or no sink in view.

rows.requirement: Keep buildings clean and sanitary and free of rodents, birds, insects, and vermin. Remove trash and waste in time.
rows.cue: Pest, overflowing trash, or visible dirt.

rows.requirement: Keep buildings in a good state of repair.
rows.cue: Broken door, damaged wall, or leak.

rows.requirement: Keep lubricants and coolants away from components and product so they do not change product quality.
rows.cue: Oil or coolant leak near open product.

rows.requirement: Clean and maintain equipment and utensils so they do not contaminate the product.
rows.cue: Residue on equipment in use.

rows.requirement: Protect clean equipment from contamination before use.
rows.cue: Clean equipment left uncovered on the floor.

rows.requirement: Identify containers, processing lines, and major equipment at all times to show their contents and, when needed, the process phase.
rows.cue: Container or line with no label.

rows.requirement: Handle and store components, containers, and closures so they do not become contaminated.
rows.cue: Open component container left uncovered.

rows.requirement: Store bagged or boxed components off the floor, with enough space to clean and inspect.
rows.cue: Boxes on the floor, or packed tight against each other.

rows.requirement: Identify each container with a lot code and its status: quarantined, approved, or rejected.
rows.cue: Container with no lot code or status label.

rows.requirement: Identify rejected components and hold them under a quarantine system so no one uses them.
rows.cue: Rejected material stored with released stock.

rows.requirement: Keep drug product containers and closures clean.
rows.cue: Dirty container or closure in use.

rows.requirement: Store the labels for each product separately and identify them. Limit access to authorized people.
rows.cue: Mixed label stock, or label storage open to anyone.

rows.requirement: Separate packaging and labeling from operations on other products to prevent mixups and cross-contamination.
rows.cue: Two products on one packaging line at the same time.

rows.requirement: Identify filled containers that wait for labeling.
rows.cue: Filled containers with no identification.

rows.requirement: Inspect the packaging and labeling area immediately before use. Confirm that earlier products and materials are gone.
rows.cue: Leftover product or labels on the line at start-up.

rows.requirement: Quarantine drug products until the quality control unit releases them.
rows.cue: Unreleased product in release stock.

rows.requirement: Keep an equipment log of cleaning, maintenance, and use.
rows.cue: No log at or near the equipment.

rows.requirement: Identify hazards that can cause harm, in routine and non-routine work.
rows.cue: Any physical hazard in view that the site has not addressed.

rows.topic: Eliminating hazards and reducing OH&S risks
rows.requirement: Apply the hierarchy of controls: remove the hazard first, then substitute, engineer, use administrative controls, and use PPE last.
rows.cue: Hazard with PPE as the only control and no guard or barrier.

rows.requirement: Plan for emergencies. Provide first aid and fire-fighting equipment and keep them ready.
rows.cue: Blocked exit, extinguisher, eyewash, or alarm.

rows.requirement: React to a nonconformity, find its cause, and take corrective action.
rows.cue: The same violation recurs at the same place.

rows.requirement: Monitor the cleanroom to show it keeps its performance.
rows.cue: Monitor or alarm display shows an out-of-range value.

rows.requirement: Design and build the cleanroom so it keeps its cleanliness class.
rows.cue: Damaged seals, gaps, or rough surfaces in a cleanroom.

rows.requirement: Operate the cleanroom with controlled personnel entry, gowning, material transfer, and cleaning.
rows.cue: Gowning step skipped, door held open, or fast movement in a cleanroom.
